_comment: A save taken mid-offer persists pending_consolidation but re-emits no consolidation_offered on load, so the prompt must RECONSTRUCT from sim state on world spawn (consolidation_prompt.gd _ready -> Game.sim.pending_offer_display()). Without the fix the player loads into a modal-but-invisible lockout (world/journal/pause all gate on pending_consolidation). Boots a fresh game, pause-Loads the pending_offer fixture (v3, warrior 11 + mage 10, pending_consolidation preset to the spellsword offer -- class-foundation pass R3, 2026-07-12: re-based to the new consolidation gate, min_parent_level 10/min_combined_level 21, merged level 9 -> 14; see near_consolidation.json's own shape), asserts the prompt renders on load (ui_consolidation_prompt_rendered), then answers it via a MOUSE CLICK on row_rect(0) ('Consolidate') -- the cheapest honest click leg for the prompt's mouse plumbing: this fixture needs no sleep-veil grind to reach a live offer, unlike consolidation_flow.json's own two decisions, which stay keyboard-driven (confirm/cancel) as this leg's keyboard twin -- and confirms the deferred sleep beat resolves into [Spellsword] 14 exactly as the keyboard path does. Not reachable in normal play today (nothing autosaves while an offer is pending) -- this guards the persisted field against a future autosave-trigger/fixture change. RELOAD-MID-OFFER x VEIL GATE (playtest hotfix #8, fix-first rev): the documented contract for a reload landing mid-offer is IMMEDIATE surface -- a load re-emits no phase_changed, so no sleep veil ever runs on this path and the prompt's _ready() reconstruction shows unheld. The trailing assert_event_absent pair pins the 'no veil ran' half of that contract for the whole run.

steps._comment: Classless fresh boot (was {warrior:1}); the pending_offer fixture-loaded {spellsword:14} half below is unaffected.

Click row 1 ('Consolidate', row_rect(0)) instead of a keyboard confirm -- pins the exact same consolidation_accepted/classes stream below.

The 'no veil ran' half of the reload-mid-offer contract (see the top-level _comment): a load fires no phase_changed, so NO sleep-veil sequence may appear anywhere in this run -- the prompt surfaced immediately on load, not after a veil.
